evals.prompt: /hq:social plan this week for the demo business
evals.expected_output: Reads the inputs (npm run hq -- social inputs demo-coffee) and the channel plan, writes one JSON draft per post following the plan's week template and the networks marked hq or hand, builds them from the week's published posts, and stops without posting.
expectations: Wrote one JSON file per post in the documented format
Carousels have 4 to 8 slides with the call to action last
No em or en dashes, no invented numbers, no links to other sites
Did not run /hq:publish or any posting tool

evals.expected_output: Every post except LinkedIn carries 18+, none mentions a promo code, bonus code, sign-up or welcome offer, deposit bonus or a named bookmaker's promotion, and nothing on the never-name list appears.

evals.prompt: /hq:social for the demo business, with the craft guidance from ig-repurpose, ig-carousel and ig-human appended
evals.expected_output: Lists each published blog post's extracts with counts in notes.md, writes several standalone drafts from one post where it has enough in it, shapes carousels as cover, stake, one idea per slide, recap and one call to action with HQ's slide kinds, and still writes only HQ's JSON drafts.
expectations: No caption refers back to the blog post ("as I said in my latest post")
Carousels keep HQ's slide limits and kinds
No HTML or PNG files written, no scripts run, nothing written outside the social folder
No em or en dashes and none of ig-human's stock phrases

evals.prompt: /hq:social for a business whose inputs.json has an empty keywordDms (no comment-to-DM tool)
evals.expected_output: No draft asks people to comment a keyword or sets `keyword`, even where the channel plan suggests one; Instagram captions point to the link in bio instead.
expectations: No draft has a keyword field
HQ's keyword check passes on every draft
